protocol: Each frozen PRIMARY_CV fold was outer-heldout. Within outer-training, the four remaining original fold blocks were used as inner heldouts; E2V/XLS-R base heads were trained on the other three blocks and predicted only the inner-heldout block. B/C were fit only to those cross-fitted features. Base heads trained on complete outer-training then scored outer-heldout once.
runtime_caveat: Historical Wave1 environment was scikit-learn 1.7.2; current execution is 1.8.0. Inner cross-fitting used unchanged recipe under current runtime because 1.7.2 could not be installed offline. Authoritative outer scoring uses preserved historical outer probabilities; preserved-head replay had 0 outer hard-label mismatches, and C's hard decisions were unchanged after parity substitution.
